dramatic: The Guild seeks Greg because his slateback knowledge has become useful enough to consult, while he keeps local uncertainty separate from old-life recognition.
performance: Paid report work converts remembered expertise into current value without granting omniscience.
screenplay: Question, bounded answer, qualifier, payment is the new professional exchange.
comparison: This is progression from worker to consultant, not another creature-identification scene.

dramatic: Daro's coat resolves and Mara remains socially, revealing an independent network of work, customers, routes, bakery timing, and neighborhood movement around Lyssa.
performance: Greg hosts rather than interrogates and learns that other people's systems do not need him.
screenplay: Conversation decentralizes Greg while making the world denser.
comparison: Treating the social detail as expendable would remove exactly the lived-world function this chapter earns.

dramatic: Hessa introduces a fresh paper fin with no apparatus history to test whether prior target/control identity explains observed movement.
performance: The new fin eventually responds once, narrowing what history can plausibly explain.
screenplay: Fresh object, same position, old control creates a new experimental question.
comparison: Repetitive setup is the control surface and should remain.

dramatic: A report-only paid consultation asks Greg to identify probable ditchrunners from witness information rather than direct sight.
performance: He distinguishes strong report features from convenient but nonexclusive evidence such as missing fish.
screenplay: Expertise now includes saying what current evidence cannot establish.
comparison: The report procedure carries professional judgment and is not redundant with the slateback event.

dramatic: Greg substitutes as theatre caller and learns a hidden timing system that connects people, cues, passage geometry, and live exceptions.
performance: He updates stale paper only when an actor can explain why the live cue changed, preserving authority without worshipping the list.
screenplay: Simple calls become high-consequence coordination; bellthroats cross old-life animal knowledge into theatre work.
comparison: The chapter transfers prior lessons into a new operational role and survives intact.
